name: Gnosis Pay Zodiac Delay forged ERC-1271 module signature
summary: Gnosis Pay card Safes are guarded by Zodiac Delay modifiers whose enabled module is the account's owner Safe. The Delay authorises execTransactionFromModule either from an enabled module or from a module signature appended to calldata; for a contract signature (v = 0) Zodiac SignatureChecker._isValidContractSignature staticcalls signer.isValidSignature and compares bytes4(returnData) with 0x1626ba7e without checking the call's success. The owner Safe's ERC-1271 path (CompatibilityFallbackHandler -> checkSignatures) calls a contract owner named in the signature before checking that it is an owner and bubbles its revert data, so an attacker contract that reverts with 0x1626ba7e made any owner Safe appear to sign. The attacker queued transfers of every Safe's balance to itself through each Delay and executed them after the 180-second cooldown.

loss.notes: The canonical figure is the Gnosis Pay post-mortem's per-asset total taken by the attacker(s), USD 1,496,151 (GNO 641,159; EURe 453,175; USDC.e 399,121; SAFE 2,202; WETH 323; xDAI 135; USDC 28; USDT 7), excluding a further ~USD 300k it reports as rendered inaccessible; Gnosis later restored users, which does not reduce gross loss. The components are an exact onchain lower bound for the primary attacker EOA 0x81ba8a2b895d30280bca199c2ff75f3f058d4c6c only: Transfer logs crediting it in the 102 Delay.executeNextTx transactions of source-6 (82 sent by the EOA, 20 by its executor 0xf6a9f265012130d02fda1f39f74e9faf8388d2f6), each debiting a different card Safe behind a clone of Delay 0x4a97e65188a950dd4b0f21f9b5434daee0bbf9f5, total USD 541,172.81. EURe is counted once although the legacy wrapper 0xcb444e90d8198415266c6a2724b7900fb12fc56e mirrors each 0x420ca0f9 Transfer; two LI.FI USDC.e returns to the EOA (0x0f44354b..., 0x06191310...) are excluded. Other addresses that used the same forgery, including rescuers such as Safe 0xbb897a566146fdb959ddde80ce00c50b4f5be03f, are not attributed here.

ageReset.description: ModuleProxyFactory 0x000000000000addb49795b0f9ba5bc298cdda236 CREATE2-created the 45-byte EIP-1167 clone 0x363d3d373d3d3d363d734a97e65188a950dd4b0f21f9b5434daee0bbf9f55af43d82803e903d91602b57fd5bf3, which hardcodes the Delay mastercopy, and in the same transaction set it up for card Safe 0x915e683649ab7743f8145d0536cf5168959c9159 and enabled owner Safe 0x7f59e536f083a63b67adfe3bc793a47744dba7d8 as its only module (EnabledModule, log 54). That enabled contract module is the signer the forgery impersonates, so this creation both activated the code for this context and set the configuration the exploit needed; the clone emitted no module, owner or avatar change before the exploit.

sources.note: Anchor: debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of 0x61af4383... (block 46468498, tx index 0, status 1, from 0x81ba8a2b895d30280bca199c2ff75f3f058d4c6c) shows execTransactionFromModule (0x468721a7) into Delay clone 0xb0ca54ac663b96f526996bb6594b5b5648142673, DELEGATECALL to 0x4a97e65188a950dd4b0f21f9b5434daee0bbf9f5, STATICCALL isValidSignature (0x1626ba7e) to its enabled module, owner Safe 0x7f59e536f083a63b67adfe3bc793a47744dba7d8 (singleton 0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762, fallback handler 0xa581c4a4db7175302464ff3c06380bc3270b4037), which reaches checkSignatures (0x934f3a11) -> STATICCALL isValidSignature(bytes,bytes) (0x20c13b0b) on attacker contract 0x5a77953caa27ed4638f4dfdc665b8064d0e97a35; that frame and every parent frame revert with output 0x1626ba7e, yet the Delay emits HashExecuted (log 0) and TransactionAdded(queueNonce 2) (log 1) queuing a MultiSendCallOnly 0x38869bf66a61cf6bdb996a6ae40d5853fd43b526 delegatecall that transfers the Safe's EURe and GNO to 0x81ba8a2b. Root cause: verified Delay source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode, chainid 100) and gnosisguild/zodiac@9a9e380 SignatureChecker.sol line 160: `(, bytes memory returnData) = signer.staticcall(...isValidSignature...); return bytes4(returnData) == EIP1271_MAGIC_VALUE`; Modifier.moduleOnly accepts msg.sender or the signature's signer if modules[signer] != 0. The post-mortem gives the same cause (Zodiac 3.4.0, fix = require success). Earliest exercise: every TransactionAdded (topic0 0x4c8a9c74...) log that shares a transaction with a HashExecuted (0x8c8e19e7...) log from block 46406453 (first funding of 0x81ba8a2b, tx 0x07cfb0ec...) to 46468497 (693 txs) was traced; none has a reverted 0x1626ba7e STATICCALL returning 0x1626ba7e, and the six forged queues in block 46468498 start at tx index 0. All 403 successful execTransactionFromModule txs sent by 0x81ba8a2b show the pattern. The attacker's earlier successful forgeries (first 0x6308310829622f91545d4e1f45dbffc52546166a0aa6267acc2dbbe81792e87b, block 46414664, 2026-05-29 00:22 UTC; 47 execTransactionWithRole calls on 0xe1f6ac63e1751c1b3cc7d4461bc4b05fa788bded and 0x3e784814e072ba38a8cd4914e5a5ccf7ab3fc3d0) ran the Roles v2 mastercopy 0x9646fdad06d3e24444381f44362a3b0eb343d337, a different artifact embedding the same SignatureChecker, on Roles clones, avatars and signer Safes the attacker itself created (getcontractcreation: 0xe460aae7..., 0x478e7afd..., 0x78ac6187..., 0x38ae87dd...), moving only sDAI the attacker had sent in; they are tests of the primitive on another artifact, not earlier exercises of the Delay artifact. Loss: Etherscan V2 tokentx for 0x81ba8a2b (chainid 100); inflows after 1780272000 grouped by tx; eth_getTransactionByHash shows 102 of them call executeNextTx (0xee072baf) on 102 distinct clones whose eth_getCode is the Delay EIP-1167 runtime (82 sent by 0x81ba8a2b, 20 by 0xf6a9f265012130d02fda1f39f74e9faf8388d2f6, which 0x81ba8a2b funded with 2 xDAI in 0xb24cd4f2...); first 0x06b0fee0... (block 46468862, drains the anchor victim 0x915e683649ab7743f8145d0536cf5168959c9159 of 22871.781209340330446817 EURe and 10.973278975665717061 GNO), last 0xc6ebf1de... (block 46470919, 1780304030). Sums: GNO 2549.22617343167145762, EURe 137792.821744984302804458, USDC.e 92842.992691, WETH 0.035066243079096445, USDC 2.22175, USDT 6.758888. Prices: DefiLlama points at 1780300743-1780300745; USDT at par. Parallel actors using the same forgery (TransactionAdded recipients in blocks 46400000-46530000: 0xcccc640018f8c2b00fa45f456017ad2378eb3447 48239 queued txs, Safe 0xbb897a566146fdb959ddde80ce00c50b4f5be03f 18567 which redistributes to many user addresses, bot 0xf9db86db4ff8ea2a1364544700d076f59edbcc91 4353, 0x05c90145654aa7edd9186a96c3e6487dfeacf094 929, 0xd43d0660601e613f9097d5c75cd04ee0c19e6f65 48) are not classified; 0xf9db86db received 26221.71 legacy USDC against the post-mortem's USD 28 attacker USDC, so the post-mortem does not count all of them.

Identity: eth_getCode(0xb0ca54ac663b96f526996bb6594b5b5648142673) is 0x at block 38375009 and the 45-byte EIP-1167 runtime (keccak 0x1d094cf6d7147eb011196c4894ba6db2a2208d02f294a57ace25f2665acbca2e) embedding 0x4a97e65188a950dd4b0f21f9b5434daee0bbf9f5 at 38375010 and 46468497. Mastercopy runtime (17319 bytes) keccak 0x20a9ecd6ca32aa6dd49e911b486ffe2220a3e1ae3435514368514631314edd1c at 30781353 and 46468497, 0x at 30781352; Etherscan verified name Delay, solc 0.8.20; created by 0x53bcfaed43441c7bb6149563ec11f756739c9f6a through singleton factory 0xce0042b868300000d44a59004da54a005ffdcf9f in 0x7af83702... (block 30781353, 1699061850, CREATE2 frame). Age: callTracer of 0x49eaf2a1... (block 38375010, tx index 3, sender 0xba9a3c0a22baebe8c4926227bde32d6edc0d5d28 via 0xf9d64d54d32ee2bdceaabfa60c4c438e224427d0 and card Safe execTransaction) has CREATE2 from 0x000000000000addb49795b0f9ba5bc298cdda236 to the clone, setUp (0xa4f9edbf) from the factory, then three calls from the Safe including enableModule (0x610b5925); receipt logs 46-54: OwnershipTransferred/AvatarSet/TargetSet to 0x915e6836..., TxCooldownSet 180, TxExpirationSet 1800, EnabledModule 0x7f59e536... . Etherscan getLogs for the clone from block 0 lists only those plus TransactionAdded in 0x5cb4f849... and 0xaee8abc2... before the anchor, so no module, owner, avatar or target change; isModuleEnabled(0x7f59e536...) is true at 46468497. Basis choice: the clone's creation, not the mastercopy deployment (1699061850, which would give 81229720 s): the defect is reachable only when the Delay's enabled module is a contract whose ERC-1271 path bubbles attacker-chosen revert data, and this instance acquired that module in its creation transaction, so the instance bears on the defect. Code age 1780291570 - 1738595980 = 41695590 s (482.6 days). Other drained Safes use clones of the same mastercopy and share this target's code hash and failure id.

limitations: The USD total is the post-mortem's reported attacker take; onchain reconstruction covers only the 102 drains credited to 0x81ba8a2b895d30280bca199c2ff75f3f058d4c6c (USD 541,172.81), because many unrelated addresses, rescuers included, queued forged Delay transactions in parallel and the post-mortem does not list which it counts as attackers.
realizedAt is the last verified drain to 0x81ba8a2b895d30280bca199c2ff75f3f058d4c6c; drains by other attacker addresses may have ended later.
